The '''Leritor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Yucrales sector/Legends|Yucrales sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It sat at the intersection of the [[Askar Trace]] and another route that ran from [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]] to [[Manda/Legends|Manda]].
